scope: Development source-reading test, single analyst labels. Frozen locally before model extraction, not external preregistration.

rubric.inquiry: Explicit investigation, discovery through searching, evaluating an unknown, or technical problem solving. A mystery genre alone is insufficient.
rubric.unease: Explicit ominous, unsettling, hallucinatory or threatening presentation or atmosphere. Ordinary danger in an adventure is insufficient.
rubric.interiority: Explicit focus on inner feelings, personal reflection, memory, identity or subjective fears. A character simply appearing is insufficient.
rubric.connection: Explicit mutual support, caregiving, reconnection, belonging or human bonding. Merely naming a group is insufficient.

bm25_queries.inquiry: investigation discovery searching evaluating unknown technical problem solving
bm25_queries.unease: ominous unsettling hallucinatory threatening tension atmosphere
bm25_queries.interiority: feelings personal reflection memory identity subjective fears
bm25_queries.connection: mutual support caregiving reconnection belonging human bonding helping

metrics: Source-label micro precision/recall/F1 and macro NDCG@3 across 12 domain/criterion requests. No satisfaction metric.
failure_policy: One call; no automatic retries or substitute model.
gold_untagged: No positive support in the supplied passage, not absence from the complete work.
